answer.answer: Drug products must carry an expiration date set by stability testing, so that the product meets its standards of identity, strength, quality and purity at the time of use.

sources.title: Expiration dating.
sources.quote: (a) To assure that a drug product meets applicable standards of identity, strength, quality, and purity at the time of use, it shall bear an expiration date
